name: Political Science
school: College of Literature, Science, and the Arts

requirements.label: 120 Total Credits
requirements.hint: All credits completed at U-M plus posted transfer credit.

requirements.label: 100 LSA Credits
requirements.hint: Credits from courses recognized by LSA (most U-M courses except some SI offerings and other school-specific courses).

requirements.label: 60 BS-Eligible Credits (for BS students only)
requirements.hint: Only counts for students pursuing a Bachelor of Science.

requirements.label: 90 Credits Excluding Experiential and Independent Study Courses
requirements.hint: At least 90 credits must come from standard coursework; internships and independent study don't count.

requirements.label: 60 Credits outside Political Science
requirements.hint: Credits earned in courses outside the Political Science department(s).

requirements.label: 90 Credits of Graded Course Work, Including Transfer and Test
requirements.hint: At least 90 credits must carry a letter grade (transfer and test credit included).

requirements.label: 60 Credits of In-Residence Course Work (AA Campus and U-M Study Abroad)
requirements.hint: Credits taken on the Ann Arbor campus or through an approved U-M study abroad program.

requirements.label: 30 Credits Taken While Enrolled in LSA
requirements.hint: Credits earned while officially enrolled in LSA (as opposed to another U-M college).

requirements.label: First Year Writing Requirement
requirements.hint: one course required

requirements.label: Upper Level Writing Requirement
requirements.hint: one course required

requirements.label: Race and Ethnicity Requirement
requirements.hint: one course required

requirements.label: Quantitative Reasoning Requirement
requirements.hint: 1 QR1 or 2 QR2 courses required

requirements.label: Language Requirement
requirements.hint: one 4th term course required, C- minimum, or one course where proficiency is presumed

requirements.label: Area Distribution: 7 Credits in Humanities
requirements.hint: From approved HU-designated courses.

requirements.label: Area Distribution: 7 Credits in Natural Sciences
requirements.hint: From approved NS-designated courses.

requirements.label: Area Distribution: 7 Credits in Social Sciences
requirements.hint: From approved SS-designated courses.

requirements.label: Additional Distribution: complete 3 areas
requirements.hint: Pick any 3 of the area buckets below and hit 3 cr in each. ID credit can count toward 1, 2, or all 3 areas, so the extra ID buckets can stand in for additional areas.

requirements.label: Additional 3 Credits in Humanities
requirements.hint: Beyond the initial 7 cr Humanities.

requirements.label: Additional 3 Credits in Natural Sciences
requirements.hint: Beyond the initial 7 cr Natural Sciences.

requirements.label: Additional 3 Credits in Social Sciences
requirements.hint: Beyond the initial 7 cr Social Sciences.

requirements.label: 3 Credits in Mathematical & Symbolic Analysis
requirements.hint: From approved MSA-designated courses.

requirements.label: 3 Credits in Creative Expression
requirements.hint: From approved CE-designated courses.

requirements.label: 3 Credits in Interdisciplinary
requirements.hint: From approved ID-designated courses.

requirements.label: 3 Additional Credits in Interdisciplinary (Second Area)
requirements.hint: A second 3 cr of ID credit may stand in for a second area.

requirements.label: 3 Additional Credits in Interdisciplinary (Third Area)
requirements.hint: A third 3 cr of ID credit may stand in for a third area.

requirements.label: Introductory Courses: 2 of POLSCI 101, 111, 140, 160
requirements.hint: Choose 2 of: POLSCI 101, POLSCI 111, POLSCI 140, POLSCI 160. Prerequisites do not count toward the 30 major credits.

requirements.label: Breadth: 1 course in 4 of 5 subfields
requirements.hint: Complete 1 course in 4 of these 5 subfields: American Government, Comparative Politics, Political Theory, Methods, World Politics.

requirements.label: Subfield: American Government
requirements.hint: 1 course from the American Government subfield, per the official subfield roster on the LSA bulletin Political Science major page (effective Fall 2024). Prerequisite intro courses count toward breadth. POLSCI 385, 389, and 489 count only for approved topics; consult the department's website.

requirements.label: Subfield: Comparative Politics
requirements.hint: 1 course from the Comparative Politics subfield, per the official subfield roster on the LSA bulletin Political Science major page (effective Fall 2024). Prerequisite intro courses count toward breadth. POLSCI 385, 389, and 489 count only for approved topics; consult the department's website.

requirements.label: Subfield: Political Theory
requirements.hint: 1 course from the Political Theory subfield, per the official subfield roster on the LSA bulletin Political Science major page (effective Fall 2024). Prerequisite intro courses count toward breadth. POLSCI 389 and 489 count only for approved topics; consult the department's website.

requirements.label: Subfield: Methods
requirements.hint: 1 course from the Methods subfield, per the official subfield roster on the LSA bulletin Political Science major page (effective Fall 2024). POLSCI 389 and 489 count only for approved topics; consult the department's website. STATS 250 does not count toward the Methods requirement.

requirements.label: Subfield: World Politics
requirements.hint: 1 course from the World Politics subfield, per the official subfield roster on the LSA bulletin Political Science major page (effective Fall 2024). Prerequisite intro courses count toward breadth. POLSCI 389 and 489 count only for approved topics; consult the department's website.

requirements.label: Depth: 400-Level POLSCI Course
requirements.hint: At least 1 400-level POLSCI course is required in any depth combination.

requirements.label: Depth: 2 Courses Total, 400-Level or ULWR POLSCI
requirements.hint: Complete 2 400-level POLSCI courses, or 1 400-level POLSCI course plus 1 ULWR POLSCI course (ULWR options: POLSCI 340, 348, 364, 381, 401, 402, 407, 409, 482, 498). Both depth courses count here.

requirements.label: Major Total Credits: 30 at the 300-Level or Above
requirements.hint: Minimum 30 credits at the 300 level or above. Includes all courses used toward the major, including approved courses from other departments (audited here as POLSCI courses only). Prerequisites do not count. Additional 300 level or above POLSCI courses can be used to reach this total.

requirements.label: Major Residency: 12 Credits on the Ann Arbor Campus
requirements.hint: Minimum 12 major credits taken on the Ann Arbor campus.

requirements.label: Non-Independent Study or Experiential Coursework: 22 Credits
requirements.hint: At least 22 major credits from standard coursework; independent study and experiential courses (such as POLSCI 383, 384, 398, 399) do not count.

requirements.label: Non-Internship (POLSCI 399) Coursework: 26 Credits
requirements.hint: At least 26 major credits from courses other than the POLSCI 399 internship.
